facts.fact: The dark stretch beyond the toppled door cairn is about two hundred paces (ninety-one slate steps by Ila's count); Kunal crosses it by memory and a route-song ('Door to the shoulder, shoulder to the pair, count the slate steps and don't look where'). The light returns at the next intact keeper cairn on the shoulder, per F687.
Kunal asked his grandmother about the guest when he was eight; his father told him before he died that she had never told him either.
Kunal tells Ila truly that he is breaking the winter rule because Raghu has the name and the rope forbids waiting for thaw.
